title: Distinguish a nondemolition Bell check from destructive local parity
statement: Nondemolition XX-positive projection preserves Phi+ and creates a Bell pair from|00> with probability1/2. Destructive local X readout followed by parity coarsening leaves a mixture of|++> and|-->, with Phi+ fidelity1/2. Equal parity probabilities do not establish the same resource-and-memory instrument; a separated nondemolition XX needs shared entanglement or a nonlocal port.
